description.value: Giant Langley is an authorized Giant brand bicycle dealership in Langley, BC, stocking a full range of road, mountain, gravel, and electric bikes alongside an extensive accessories selection. The shop runs a structured three-tier service department, and bikes purchased in-store receive complimentary multi-year service coverage with no appointment needed. Touring cyclists will find useful gear including bags, panniers, racks, fenders, and lights, along with a workshop capable of handling most mechanical needs.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 28m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and active, with news posts dated May 2026 confirming the business is operating. The /ca/service subpage explicitly details a tiered repair operation with drop-in service for in-store-purchased bikes and appointment-based service for others, and explicitly restricts e-bike service to Giant, Liv, and Momentum brands. The accessories menu lists bags & panniers, racks, fenders, lights, and locks, confirming touring-relevant parts are stocked; no pump, washroom, rental, or charging evidence appears anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM name field is 'Giant' but the business presents as 'Giant Langley' on its website; the OSM branch=Langley tag captures this but the name field alone is ambiguous among Giant dealers.
No phone number in OSM tags; phone 604-534-3993 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service Giant dealership with a dedicated service department, drop-in repair capability, and touring-relevant accessories — a clear and useful resource for cycling tourists passing through the Langley area.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Accessories menu lists bags & panniers, racks, fenders, lights, and locks explicitly

E-bike service.detail: Website states 'We do not work on any e-bike brands except Giant, Liv and Momentum' — confirming e-bike service is offered for those three brands
